record.question: Which of the following statement is false about nuclear (radioactive) waste disposal?
options: Radioactive wastes has very little space requirement for its storage and reduction of intensity of its harmful effects with time.
Low and intermediate level radioactive wastes are usually disposed of by shallow land burial and emplacement in suitable abandoned mines.
The long- lived radioactive wastes in a monitored place for ~10 years.
Storage of radioactive wastes in a geological formation is the best mode of disposal available, granitic and basaltic terrains in India.
